prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person wearing a black jacket with white stripes on the sleeves, black pants, and a black cap with a white front panel"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08", "P09"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01","P02","P03","P04","P08","P09"],"uncertain":["P05","P06","P07"],"reason":"P01, P02, P03, P04, P08, and P09 clearly show a black jacket with white stripes on the sleeves, black pants, and a black cap with a white front panel. P05, P06, and P07 are uncertain because their views are too blurry or obscured to confirm the white stripes on the sleeves or the white front panel of the cap. P07 wears a different style hat (fedora-like) and may not match the cap description. P06 and P05 are in motion or partially obscured, making sleeve details and cap front panel unclear."}
